summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Tartan PWA. 13/13 backend pytest cases pass covering root, list tartans, get tartan+stats, map, share/invite context, create tartan (with persistence), join flow with parent attribution, chain lineage, idempotency, verified/unverified device split, tartan-level verified counter increment, reports, and 404s. Frontend Playwright covered: home loads with featured Puntland card + total reach counter, language toggle EN<->SO, Start Tartan modal creates tartan and redirects to /me/{share}, /me dashboard renders share link + copy + WA/SMS/native/QR buttons + QR modal with SVG + milestone progress + lineage, /t/puntland shows global-stats + chain-map + zoom in/out controls, join flow from tartan view attaches under initiator (Amina shown as inviter in lineage), membership persisted in localStorage (View-my-branch button shown on revisit), /j/j4atawQ7lw invite landing shows inviter avatar + headline + live preview stats + Join CTA, Report dialog submits successfully and shows moderator toast.

minor.issue: initiator_share_token is exposed in tartan_public serialization; if this is intentional for owner-flows it is fine, but it lets anyone using /api/tartans (list) fetch the flagship then read the initiator's private share link. Consider hiding for non-owners.

design_issues.screen: All dialogs (JoinModal, StartTartanDialog, ReportDialog, QR modal)
issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby — accessibility warning in console (non-blocking).

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to Radix DialogContent to remove a11y warnings.
(Optional) Consider hiding initiator_share_token from the public /api/tartans list response since it grants inviter-attribution power.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py join_tartan walks ancestors serially with N async round-trips per join — fine for MVP but O(depth) per write; consider batch $inc with an ancestors[] array cached on member docs for deeper trees.

verified_downstream is incremented on ancestors but never set to 0 at member creation — reads via $inc auto-init to 0, but explicit init in the member doc would be cleaner and prevent missing-field foot-guns.
In-memory _ip_hits rate limiter is per-process; will not work behind multiple workers. Acceptable for MVP.
SharePanel uses window.location.origin for share URL — correct; note that opening /j/{token} on same origin will attach share cookie context correctly.
TartanView.doJoin sends parent_share_token: null so backend falls back to tartan.initiator_share_token — matches spec ('attaches under the initiator').
Home totalReach sums verified_members of all tartans — reasonable, but AnimatedNumber tween may briefly display low values during load.
test_credentials: No auth. Puntland tartan token; flagship initiator share token j4atawQ7lw (Amina).
seed_data_creation: Backend seed_flagship created ~41 Puntland members on startup (idempotent by featured:true). UI test created 1 TEST_UI_Chain and a couple of TEST_ joiners; not cleaned up (kept for regression). No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_tartan_api.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/test_tartan_api.py -v`. Verified/unverified split is enforced by same-device cookie; requests.Session preserves the httponly `td` cookie for backend tests. Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and axios withCredentials:true; localStorage.clear() resets the 'membership' cache so /t/puntland shows Join CTA again. Note the flagship initiator share token 'j4atawQ7lw' is the seeded value and matches production; the backend seed also seeded from the `TARTAN_SECRET` in .env — do not change it.
